pages.title: Giant Eland
pages.text: The giant eland ($(o)Taurotragus derbianus$()), also called Lord Derby's eland, is a spiral-horned antelope of the wooded savannas of West and Central Africa.$(br2)It is one of the largest antelope in the world, and both males and females carry long, tightly spiralled horns.$(br2)Giant eland are browsers, feeding on leaves and shoots, and use their horns to break down branches out of reach.
